_what: HAND-CURATED mapping from RadioAnatome canonical anatomy ids (ontology.json) to BodyParts3D 4.0 / FMA concepts as packaged by Human Atlas (github.com/ashemag/human-atlas). Names were NOT assumed to match: every row was chosen by reading the concept's element list. bp3d_import.py consumes this file; ontology.py merges the fma/coverage fields back into ontology.json.

_kinds.concept: one FMA concept; all its BodyParts3D element meshes (optionally filtered to `systems`) ARE the structure
_kinds.composite: several FMA concepts together ARE the structure (e.g. left + right, or the three erector spinae columns)
_kinds.related: BodyParts3D 4.0 ships NO surface mesh for the structure itself; the listed concepts are anatomically related sub-structures shown as 'related' only, never as the structure
_kinds.region: a container structure (Abdomen, Thorax...) that corresponds to a 3D body region, not to a mesh
_kinds.system: a container structure that corresponds to a whole 3D system layer
_kinds.none: no BodyParts3D counterpart at all; `reason` says why

_coverage: full = the meshes are the whole structure. partial = the structure exists but only part of it has geometry. none = related/region/system/none rows.

ABDOMEN.note: Container structure; FMA9577 'abdomen' in BP3D is a bag of wall muscles + hip bones, not a surface. Linked to the 3D region instead.

AORTA.note: Whole aorta. The abdomen CT modules label only the abdominal segment (FMA3789); the whole vessel is shown so the correlation is not clipped.

AUTOCHTHONOUS_BACK_MUSCLE.note: TotalSegmentator 'autochthon' = erector spinae (iliocostalis, longissimus, spinalis) + semispinalis. BP3D has no single 'erector spinae' concept.

BRAIN.note: BP3D models gyri, nuclei, ventricles, brainstem and cerebellum, not a closed cerebral surface. Ventricles were mis-filed as 'cardiac' upstream and are relabelled nervous on import.

BRAINSTEM.note: Midbrain + pons + medulla oblongata (+ peduncles, colliculi).

CEREBELLAR_CORTEX.reason: BP3D ships the cerebellum as one mesh (FMA67944); it is not split into cortex and white matter.

CEREBELLAR_WHITE_MATTER.reason: BP3D ships the cerebellum as one mesh (FMA67944); it is not split into cortex and white matter.

CEREBRAL_CORTEX.note: BP3D has named gyri and lobes, not a continuous cortical ribbon. Frontal-lobe cortex concepts + parietal/temporal/occipital lobes are combined.

CEREBRAL_WHITE_MATTER.note: White matter of each hemisphere plus the internal capsules (FMA241998 alone omits the capsules its lateral children include).

COLON.note: Cecum, ascending, transverse, descending colon and rectum. BP3D 4.0 isa set has no sigmoid colon mesh.

CORONA_RADIATA.reason: Not modelled in BP3D 4.0 (white matter is one mesh per hemisphere).

FOOT.note: Skeleton of the foot (26 bones per side); the CT module's 'Foot' is the whole region.

FOURTH_VENTRICLE.note: Mis-filed as 'cardiac' upstream; relabelled nervous on import.

HAND.note: Skeleton of the hand; the CT module's 'Hand' is the whole region.

HAND_BONE.note: Carpal bones + metacarpals + phalanges of the fingers.

HEART.note: BP3D 4.0 isa set models chamber cavities, atrial walls, one ventricular wall and the valve leaflets; there is no single closed heart surface.

LATERAL_VENTRICLE.note: Mis-filed as 'cardiac' upstream; relabelled nervous on import.

LIVER.note: BP3D 4.0 isa set has NO liver surface mesh: only the caudate lobe, the biliary tree and the intrahepatic vessels. Shown as related structures.

LOWER_LIMB.note: Skeleton of the lower limb; the CT knee module's 'Lower limb' is the whole region.

LOWER_LOBE_LEFT.note: No lobe surface in BP3D 4.0 isa set; the lobe's segmental bronchial tree is shown as related.

LOWER_LOBE_RIGHT.note: No lobe surface in BP3D 4.0 isa set; the lobe's segmental bronchial tree is shown as related.

LUNG.note: No lung surface in BP3D 4.0 isa set; the bronchial tree is shown as related.

MIDDLE_LOBE_RIGHT.note: No lobe surface in BP3D 4.0 isa set; the lobe's segmental bronchial tree is shown as related.

PARANASAL_SINUS.reason: BP3D models bones, not air spaces; no maxillary/frontal/sphenoid/ethmoid sinus cavities exist in the isa set.

PELVIS.note: Container structure. The bony pelvis (FMA16580 = both hip bones + sacrum) is reachable through HIP_BONE and SACRUM.

SKULL.note: Cranial + facial bones (the upstream concept also lists eyeball parts, filtered out here).

SMALL_BOWEL.note: Jejunum + ileum. Duodenum is its own structure.

SUBARACHNOID_SPACE.reason: BP3D models parenchyma and vessels, not CSF spaces.

TELENCEPHALON.note: Gyri, lobes, basal ganglia, white matter; no closed hemispheric surface.

THIRD_VENTRICLE.note: Mis-filed as 'cardiac' upstream; relabelled nervous on import.

TORSO.note: Container structure of the living-patient torso modules.

UPPER_LOBE_LEFT.note: No lobe surface in BP3D 4.0 isa set; the lobe's segmental bronchial tree is shown as related.

VENTRAL_DIENCEPHALON.note: SynthSeg's composite 'ventral DC' has no FMA equivalent; hypothalamus + diencephalon parts are shown.

VERTEBRAL_CANAL.reason: A space, not a structure, in BP3D. Use SPINAL_CORD and the vertebrae.

_system_corrections._why: Human Atlas's curated display-system table files several nervous-system parts under 'cardiac' or 'sensory'. Corrected on import; recorded in HUMAN_ATLAS_PROVENANCE.md as a modification.
